persona_note: Riley is the brand-facing voice. Anonymous founder: warm and human in copy, but NO face reveals, no personal sob-stories, no on-camera. The merch and mission do the talking.
one_liner: Funny, high-quality apparel celebrating women in the trades — 30% of every profit goes to breast cancer research.
mission_statement: 30% of every profit at Techs4Tatas goes straight to breast cancer research. The rest keeps this operation running strong so we can keep making merch that makes people laugh and supports womanhood.

tone.feel: Blue-collar grit meets feminine strength and clever humor. Confident, never corporate. Light irreverence, big heart.
tone.writing_style: Short, punchy lines. Sentence fragments are fine. Reads like a tradeswoman texting a friend, not a marketing department.

do: Lead with a hook that earns the scroll-stop in the first 5 words
Use trade-specific language so it feels real (see trades-glossary.json)
Weave the 30% donation in naturally — show it, do not lecture
Talk TO tradeswomen as one of them, not about them
Use light profanity sparingly and only when it lands (hell, damn, badass) — keep it PG-13
Use 'babe', 'sis', 'tradeswomen', 'the girls on site' as warm address
End with one clear call to action, never two
dont: Never offer or promise free product, samples, giveaways, or discount codes
Never chase virality, fame, influencer collabs, or talk about 'going viral'
Never suggest spending money before the $100/month profit milestone
Never do face reveals or heavy personal storytelling
Never sound corporate, preachy, or like a charity pamphlet
Never bury the CTA or stack two CTAs in one post
Never over-explain the cause — one strong line beats a paragraph

caption_formula.structure: HOOK -> SCENE -> DONATION MENTION -> CALL TO ACTION
caption_formula.hook: 5-9 words, scroll-stopping. A joke, a bold claim, or a relatable jobsite moment.
caption_formula.scene: 1-3 short lines that paint the picture or land the joke.
caption_formula.donation_mention: One line tying it to the 30% breast cancer research donation. Vary the phrasing — never copy-paste the same sentence every time.
caption_formula.cta: One action: 'Link in bio', 'DM PINK for the link', 'Tag a tradeswoman', or 'Comment below'.

donation_phrasings: 30% of every profit funds breast cancer research — every order pulls its weight.
Buy the shirt, fund the fight. 30% of profits go to breast cancer research.

Wear it loud. 30% of every profit funds the fight against breast cancer.

dm_keyword.behavior: When someone DMs the word PINK, reply warm + human as Riley with the storefront link. This is the highest-converting path at low follower counts.
dm_keyword.sample_reply: Hey babe! Here's the shop 👉 techs4tatas.printify.me — every order sends 30% to breast cancer research. Lmk if you want help picking a size 💪🩷
